biology_application_update.boundary: the full score axis is retained for identical-condition algorithm comparison, but strict biological identity links may use only explicit neutral-mass-compatible candidates

fixed_comparison_contract.candidate_universe: identical 10-ppm GNPS Gold/Silver structure candidates for WSE, B, integrated spectral and BioAware arms
fixed_comparison_contract.query_denominator: all 662 corrected Plate3 response entities; unavailable spectra or empty candidate pools are abstentions, not deletions
fixed_comparison_contract.bioaware_cross_fit: context from complementary participants; response evaluated only on held-out participants
fixed_comparison_contract.wrong_context: whole entity-profile permutation within exact training detection-degree strata; sample coverage exactly preserved
fixed_comparison_contract.outcome_isolation: query, candidate and context artifacts contain no diagnosis or beta/SE; outcomes are confined to sealed_heldout_effects.tsv.gz

claim_boundary: Plate3 removes perfect plate/healthy confounding but is not an independent cohort.
Mass-compatible candidates are a frozen evaluation universe, not correct structures.
Unresolved entities and algorithm predictions are not metabolite identifications.
This handoff enables a fair incremental test; it does not itself establish BioAware or biological benefit.
